learnings: When a report ends in tool errors (API failures, crashes, timeouts), it should be treated as missing data rather than contributing to an inconclusive verdict that triggers escalation

A single successful comprehensive review from a capable model should be sufficient to resolve a package as safe when the failed report's issues are clearly infrastructure-related rather than security findings
